payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_record_migrate.py::test_each_compared_kind_that_disagrees_or_runs_past_the_ledger_is_refused stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'The refusal reason is reworded.' applied to saffron/record/migrate.py as an edit. The claim was "For each of the thirteen compared kinds, a ref holding a live `task_created` and the ledger's first fact of that kind is migrated. It gains the rest of every compared kind, then the ledger's state. The same ref holding every fact of that kind, the last one's payload carrying one extra key, is refused with today's reason and gains no fact. So is the ref holding every fact of that kind and one more. For each kind with two facts, a ref holding both true facts is migrated and gains the rest of every other compared kind, then the ledger's state. A ref holding only the second is refused. So is a ref holding both, the first carrying one extra key. A ref holding no `task_created` is refused the same way.". Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_saffron_gates.py::test_the_fast_gates_name_their_tool_and_pass_on_a_clean_tree[format], and the criterion's witness did not fail.
